label.name: Name
label.label: Label
label.wrap: After the last option, start again at the first
label.passthru: Send a message when an input message selects an option

placeholder.label: Text above the widget (optional, HTML allowed)

errors.invalidOptions: msg.options must be an array of values or of objects with value and label, e.g. ["Off","On"] or [{"label":"On","value":"on"}]
errors.invalidIndex: msg.index __index__ is not a position between 0 and the number of options (__count__) minus 1
errors.invalidStep: msg.step __step__ is not a whole number
errors.invalidUiUpdate: msg.ui_update must be an object, e.g. {"label":"Mode"}
errors.invalidUiUpdateValue: msg.ui_update.__key__ must be text, a number or null
